question: I imagine that now that the third season of the anime has aired, you’ve heard all sorts of reactions to it. Of all the things people have said, is there any comment or reaction that made you especially happy to hear? ✨
answer:
It was really interesting, and thanks to Regulus-san, it became a huge topic of conversation, so it was a wonderful third season.

I was happy to hear comments like “This part of Season 3 was…”, but what made me especially happy was hearing, “I heard people talking about Season 3, so I went back and watched Seasons 1 and 2.”

Season 1 was in 2016, so the fact that someone watched Season 1 from nine years ago, found it interesting, and then caught up all the way to Season 3 makes me incredibly happy.

And then there are the comments praising Emilia! (laughs)
